notes.title: Update 78
notes.content:
- rebuilt every zone, area, and monster from the ground up
- fights no longer have randomly generated monsters
- added mini-mimics that can show up randomly
- new elite type: chilling
- more AI improvements
- monsters can now attack other monsters outside of their faction.
- enemies should no longer heal you
- most enemies block less
- enemies display their weapon type under their name
- NG+ modifiers now show on the map screen
- NG+3+ now generates additional run modifiers
- redesigned new run settings screen
- redesigned finale screen
- doubled Ego gained from clearing areas
- VIPerk Ego boost increased to 10%/lv
- VIPerk Cash boost increased to 10%/lv
- fixed poison wide attacks being as strong as single target
- freeze threshold goes up by 4 every time you get frozen
- player can be frozen
- slots are now gained after every fight
- cost of slots and totems is random between two points
- added fog to fights
- new shield bash animation
- map can be scrolled with W,S, UP and DOWN
- codex can be scrolled with W,S, Up or Down
   holding shift increases the speed 5x
- fixed clover not healing really for anything
- hypoheart heals 1%/turn of your health now
- fixed altars overhealing, again
- added code screen for promos
- fixed ego booster not working, sorry!
   use code 'bigsorry' for 50k Ego

notes.title: Update 73
notes.content:
Hello! We are getting close to final release with this update. The entire combat system has been completely rewritten. Please provide feedback on combat as it is now, because I can only test so much.

- reworked the entire ability system to normalize difficulty 
 - totems you can't use no longer drop 
 - firebug is now a totem, Chilli Pepper 
 - retainer is now a totem, Turtle Shell 
 - brutal is now a totem, Monster Claw 
 - hexmaster is now a totem, Crow Feather 
 - 14 new perks 
 - 5 new magic attack sounds 
 - pauldron doubled to 200 shield 
 - all shield sources gain buffs from relics 
 - increased chance of totems from chests 
 - fixed relic damage bonus 
 - remade this screen again 
 - fixed poison calculations, again 
 - rerolling now removes zapped status 
 - fixed skip turn button not lighting up after rerolling 
 - freeze threshold upped to 12 
 - freeze now decays 1/turn 
 - frozen has it's own status and icon 
 - getting a drink now costs 10% cash 
 - swearing now happens when someone is hit by a crit 
 - fixed boss monster reels not being as large as they should 
 - added window scaling to pc versions 
 check the settings menu 
 - fancy new mouse for pc version 
 - added basic pc controls to fights based on Oxytropis' suggestion 
 Q,W,E to select an ability. 
 1,2,3,4 to select a target. 
 S targets self. Tab toggles respin. 
  Space skips turn. 
  
 --hotfix 71-- 
 - fixed crash on startup 
  
 --hotfix 72-- 
 - fixed crash on runner screen 
 - fixed crash on viperk screen 
  
 --hotfix 73-- 
 - reduced respins to 1 per fight. 
  3 per fight was far too powerful and encouraged glass cannons"

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
B0.58 Changelog:
 - Steam Prep, Part 3
- adjusted how runs are saved. This should fix most crashes.
- Fixed combust animation
- Fixed elec boost not working
- new event: Found Scraps
- immolated no longer burn
- poison now doesn't increase when you land on poisoned
- NG+ no longer increases when looping endless mode. This change was actually made a few patches ago.
- player bleed damage taken scales with NG+ now.
- player burn damage taken scales with NG+ now.
- Removed Legendary and Mythical Essence from dailies and capsules
- doubled scrap reward from common, but increased scrap cost to craft common
- nerfed Altar Healing
- Healing Boost reduced by 90%
- Relics once again spawn at the players level plus current NG+. This should help the player climb a little faster.
- cash no longer influences Ego gain
- buffed Ego gained by winning by 10x
- buffed Ego gained by kills to 5x
